body: IPO Nov 2022 (issue ~₹587, unverified). First weekly close ₹745 → ATH ₹7,545 (Jan 2025) ≈10x. P/E 104 → 203 (2x) × implied EPS ~5.2x. Revenue FY22 ₹706 cr → FY25 ₹2,722 cr → FY26 ₹3,626 cr. Drawdown inside the run only −20%. Early signal for the upside: EMS plus the semiconductor/OSAT theme, with order-book growth and government electronics incentives, but it was always priced at 100x+. Ended: TTM EPS fell from ₹57 to ~₹40. In Dec 2025 Kotak Institutional flagged RPT disclosure mismatches and capitalised know-how (see case_study:kaynes-2025); in May 2026 Q4 FY26 PAT fell −21.5% and the stock dropped ~25% in two sessions; on 16 Nov 2026 Q2 FY27 profit fell ~62–66%, the stock −20% to a 52-week low. ₹2,890 on 19 Nov 2026 (−62% from ATH), P/E ~73, ROCE ~13%. Red flags visible early: ROCE only 13–15% and heavy working capital against a 100–200x P/E. Lesson: when a stock lists at 100x the multiple engine is already spent; only EPS can drive returns. A single earnings stumble plus a disclosure question halves the multiple.

data.early_signals: EMS/OSAT theme; low ROCE vs P/E was the warning
data.lesson: 100x IPOs leave only the EPS engine
data.note: Prices: screener.in weekly closes, split/bonus-adjusted. P/E = trailing (TTM); implied EPS x = price multiple / P/E multiple.

title: Kaynes Technology 2022–2026: 10x from a 100x-P/E IPO, then −62%
